changelog.summary: Adds desktop notifications and volume control, implements notifications.read for dunst, and fixes several clipboard, audio and launcher bugs.
features: notifications.send: show a desktop notification (title, message, urgency, timeout)
audio.volume: get, set (0-100), mute or unmute the default output
notifications.read now works on systems running the dunst daemon
fixes: clipboard.write no longer stages text in a world-readable /tmp file (now private, unpredictable name)
clipboard.read reports real failures instead of returning an empty success
audio.play rejects sources starting with '-' (mpv option injection) and missing files
app.launch opens file:// paths that contain spaces or other percent-encoded characters
app.launch rejects values starting with '-' that would be read as options
media.control status reports 'no_player' instead of ok when nothing is playing
app.launch reports 'app_not_found' for unknown apps instead of claiming success
media.control reports 'no_player' as an error when no player is running
app.launch can start installed desktop apps by id even when gtk-launch is broken (falls back to gio launch)
